heading: How to Do It in BC
title:
1. Find the standard for the activity in [BCCNM - Nurse Practitioners: Standards](https://www.bccnm.ca/NP/PracticeStandards/Pages/Default.aspx); most have a page of FAQs and case studies under [BCCNM learning resources](https://www.bccnm.ca/NP/learning/Pages/Default.aspx).
2. If the standards don't answer it, send the question to [BCCNM Standards Support](https://public.bccnm.ca/standardssupport).
3. For prescribing questions, start with [Prescribing Authority](Prescribing%20Authority.md).

heading: How to Do It in Ontario
title:
1. Find the rule for the activity in the [CNO Nurse Practitioner standard](https://www.cno.org/Assets/CNO/Documents/Standard-and-Learning/Practice-Standards/41038_strdrnec.pdf) and the [Scope of Practice standard](https://www.cno.org/Assets/CNO/Documents/Standard-and-Learning/Practice-Standards/49041-scope-of-practice.pdf).
2. Check the [Nursing Act, 1991](https://www.ontario.ca/laws/statute/91n32) and its regulations for the NP controlled acts.
3. Read the standard or guideline for the topic on the [CNO standards and guidelines](https://cno.org/standards-learning/standards-guidelines/standards-guidelines) page.
